data.one_liner: FIFO cache with time-based expiration and mutex-like in-flight locking for async searches.
data.what_it_does: Provides a FIFO cache implementation where entries expire automatically according to time and size limits. It also includes mutex-like methods to prevent redundant concurrent fetches for the same cache key.
use_when: You need to cache search results to avoid redundant backend requests
You want time-based expiration alongside a FIFO size limit
You need to prevent multiple concurrent operations from fetching the same key simultaneously
avoid_when: You need complex LRU or LFU cache eviction policies
strengths: Includes built-in time-based expiration and FIFO size limits
Provides in-flight key tracking for mutex-like search usage
weaknesses: In-memory cache only with no built-in persistence
